@graph.name: Custom Aluminum Extrusion Service
@graph.description: End-to-end custom aluminum extrusion of 6063, 6061, 6005, 6082 and other 6xxx alloys. Press range 450T to 7,500T, circumscribing circle up to 380 mm, profile weight 0.1–20 kg/m. Includes DFM review, die manufacturing, sampling, mass production, cut-to-length and packing.

audience.audienceType: OEM manufacturers, fabricators, importers and distributors

priceSpecification.description: From USD 2.30/kg FOB Qingdao depending on alloy, temper, surface and volume.

@graph.name: Aluminum Anodizing Service
@graph.description: In-house anodizing line for architectural and industrial profiles: clear, black, bronze, champagne, gold, matte, sandblast, brushed. Film thickness 10–25 μm to Qualanod and AAMA 611 standards. Maximum part length 7 m.

priceSpecification.description: Add-on USD 0.35–0.85/kg depending on color, film thickness and finish.

@graph.name: Aluminum Powder Coating & Fluorocarbon (PVDF) Coating Service
@graph.serviceType: Powder coating and fluorocarbon coating of aluminum profiles
@graph.description: Vertical and horizontal powder-coating lines: any RAL/Pantone color, matte, gloss, textured. PVDF fluorocarbon coating to AAMA 2605 with 25-year color warranty. Wood-grain heat-transfer printing for architectural finishes.

priceSpecification.description: Add-on USD 0.40–1.50/kg depending on system (powder vs PVDF) and color.

@graph.name: Aluminum CNC Machining & Deep Processing Service
@graph.description: Precision deep processing of aluminum profiles: 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milling, drilling, tapping, sawing, punching, bending and assembly. Tolerances within ±0.01 mm. Includes 4500 / 6500 Prady machining centers and 5-axis CNC.

priceSpecification.description: Quoted per part — typical range USD 0.50–8.00 per machined feature depending on complexity.

@graph.name: Aluminum Extrusion Mold / Die Design Service
@graph.serviceType: Custom aluminum extrusion die design and manufacturing
@graph.description: Full custom die design, FEM flow simulation, H13 tool steel mold manufacturing, nitriding, die correction and storage. Solid, hollow, semi-hollow and thermal-break profile dies. 7–12 day lead time.

priceSpecification.description: USD 200–500 (solid), USD 500–1,500 (hollow / thermal break). Mold fee refundable above 5–10 tonne cumulative orders.
